content: On the Hour, Level Five (the Sufis) hold that all things return to their source. The manifestation of the form of the Real in full perfection corresponds to the period from Adam to Muḥammad, who is Seal of the prophets through the perfection of the transcript (vażʿ) revealed to him; whoever understands that perfect form as it is contains all that has been and will be.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
